To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the best algorithm for overlapping community detection is BigClam, 2) the best algorithm(s) for disjoint community detection is (are) Louvain, 3) the best algorithm in both categories is InfoMap, 4) there is not a single best algorithm, and 5) the best algorithm is dependent on the network type.
